avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Kava potentiates CNS depression and may counteract flumazenil's reversal effects; hepatotoxicity risk with both agents
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue kava kava use prior to flumazenil administration and avoid concurrent use

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce hepatic metabolism and reduce flumazenil efficacy; potential serotonin interactions
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor flumazenil effectiveness; consider alternative antidepressant if benzodiazepine reversal is critical

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depressant effects may complicate assessment of flumazenil reversal efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient alertness and CNS status closely during flumazenil administration

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CNS depression may interfere with clinical assessment of benzodiazepine reversal
caution_supplements.action: Document use and observe for delayed emergence from sedation

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Residual CNS depression may persist despite flumazenil reversal; alcohol potentiates CNS effects
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid alcohol for at least 24 hours following flumazenil administration

monitoring_notes: Flumazenil has minimal food/supplement interactions due to its short half-life and primary use in acute reversal settings. Monitor for resedation as flumazenil's duration may be shorter than the benzodiazepine being reversed, particularly with long-acting agents.
